Title: Public Preview: Azure Cosmos DB Vercel integration

Body.Content:
The Azure Cosmos DB Vercel integration can improve your productivity since you can now easily create Vercel applications with a backend database already configured. This feature can help you onboard Azure Cosmos DB faster with features like elastic scalability, low latency, and automatic code deployments.

The integration of Vercel with Azure Cosmos DB provides you with a powerful and flexible platform for developing, deploying, and scaling web applications. This allows you to take advantage of the benefits of serverless architecture and a distributed database service to create high-performance, secure, and scalable web applications. 

Learn More.
